    Depth of vertices and supports of syzygies #

    For directed data, the depth of a vertex x is the number of its strict successors (DirData.depth); it drops strictly along nonzero e_y A e_x with x ≠ y (depth_lt). A module M lives in depth < d if e_x M = 0 whenever depth x ≥ d (LivesBelow).
